# Synthetic fixture (OBS-08): Prometheus Operator resources.
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: Prometheus
metadata:
  name: k8s
  namespace: monitoring
spec:
  replicas: 2
  scrapeInterval: 5s
  retention: 30d
  serviceMonitorSelector: {}
---
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: Prometheus
metadata:
  name: default-interval
spec:
  retention: 90d
---
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: Prometheus
metadata:
  name: default-retention
spec:
  scrapeInterval: 5s
---
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: Prometheus
metadata:
  name: short-retention
spec:
  scrapeInterval: 1s
  retention: 7d
---
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1alpha1
kind: PrometheusAgent
metadata:
  name: agent
spec:
  scrapeInterval: 10s
  remoteWrite:
    - url: https://aps-workspaces.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/workspaces/ws-1234abcd/api/v1/remote_write
      sigv4:
        region: ap-south-1

# Synthetic fixture (OBS-08): Prometheus config in a ConfigMap, served by a Deployment in the same file.
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: prometheus-config
  namespace: monitoring
data:
  prometheus.yml: |
    global:
      scrape_interval: 10s
      evaluation_interval: 30s
    scrape_configs:
      - job_name: node
        static_configs:
          - targets: ["node-exporter:9100"]
      - job_name: envoy
        scrape_interval: 1s
        static_configs:
          - targets: ["envoy:9901"]
      - job_name: kube-state-metrics
        scrape_interval: 30s
        static_configs:
          - targets: ["kube-state-metrics:8080"]
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: prometheus
  namespace: monitoring
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: prometheus
          image: quay.io/prometheus/prometheus:v3.5.0
          args:
            - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
            - --storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus
            - --storage.tsdb.retention.time=90d
        - name: config-reloader
          image: quay.io/prometheus-operator/prometheus-config-reloader:v0.85.0
